name: Biologically Inspired Spiking Neural Network in Java

mentions.name: Biologically Inspired Spiking Neural Network in Java
mentions.description: A biologically inspired spiking neural network implemented from scratch in Java, featuring homeostatic STDP, dendritic branch competition, lateral neuronal inhibition (with multiple strategies), dopamine-based rewarding, and an adaptive stabilizer. It supports multiple hemispheres and layers. The first goal is building a simple OCR system, with a longer-term aim of driving a robotic cockroach around the house with the virtual brain.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on a biological inspired spik8ng neural network written from scratch in Java. So far I implemented homeostatic STDP, dendritic branches competition, lateral neuronal inhibition (with different strategies), dopamine based rewarding and an adaptive stabilizer.
